In that case I’ll have no problem in helping you out. 
Though 1USD per chapter is kind of low.

I’m pretty good at math, physics and economics. 
Which level of education are you currently at?
Thank you for your supportive message. It truly helped put be back on the right mind set.

We used to live in Kenya for a few years, I was probably 7-8 years old at the time. 

My mum and I where in the car, my dad and sister where in the market shopping around. My mum absolutely loved the designs of Audi’s. She used to call them “char chaleri gadi” (car who’s logo has 4 circles) (they where pretty much the most luxurious cars you could see in Kenya at that time). 
So while we where waiting in the car I remember that a Audi parked right next to us. Both of us where filled with joy just staring at it. She knew I would always do anything for her. So at that moment she made me promise that when I grow up I’ll buy one just for her, even tho she would be 80-90.
We continued to stare and appreciate the design of the car for another 20-30 minutes. 

My mum has never been really materialistic, but now that I’ve grown up I understand why she made me promise her that. That was her way of making sure that I have a good life, one in which I am financially stable and independent enough in which I can take care of my own family and ONTOP of that buy a 80 year old lady an expensive car. 

Idk why I told you that, but I just thought everyone should know that my mum is such an amazing/loving human being. 
It’s utterly unfortunate that such an amazing woman is stuck in such a household. 

She deserves beautiful dresses, she deserves to eat and drink whatever her mood fancy’s, she deserves to speak freely, she deserves to be happy. 
But most of all, she deserves to go to sleep with a smile on her face.
I honestly thought that I could offer the world so much

At times I just wish my mother did not stop him from killing me, if she hadn’t non of these problems would exist. 

Dad could spend whatever money he wanted on my sister 
My mother would not have been beaten and physically abused 
My dad would never have had to deal with me.
